mapper.select: SELECT qb.id AS bank_id, qb.bank_name, count(uqn.id) AS note_count FROM user_question_note uqn INNER JOIN question_bank qb ON qb.id = uqn.bank_id AND qb.is_deleted = 0 INNER JOIN category_sub_module csm ON csm.id = qb.sub_module_id AND csm.is_deleted = 0 INNER JOIN category_module cm ON cm.id = csm.module_id AND cm.is_deleted = 0 INNER JOIN category_group cg ON cg.id = cm.group_id AND cg.is_deleted = 0 WHERE uqn.user_id = #{userId} AND uqn.is_deleted = 0 AND cg.group_type = #{groupType} GROUP BY qb.id, qb.bank_name ORDER BY qb.id DESC
SELECT uqn.question_id FROM user_question_note uqn WHERE uqn.bank_id = #{bankId} AND uqn.user_id = #{userId} AND uqn.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY uqn.updated_time DESC, uqn.id DESC
